admission.justification: Spans the old and new settings homes: the one-time whole-file move with metadata preserved and existing-destination refusal is the mechanism FAM-6M4B49's single-location guarantee depends on.

applicability: The explicit one-time upgrade move of the user settings file.
conditions: The whole JSON file moves once with metadata preserved.
An existing destination refuses the move.
No developer real settings file is moved by this leaf.
exclusions: Parsing out or copying only role settings instead of the whole file.
statement: The explicit upgrade command moves the complete user JSON file once, preserves metadata, refuses an existing destination and adds no role-key-only fallback; no developer real settings file was moved in this leaf.
